scope: Replace 39 detail composites and the existing extra column. All other actions columns and action_accounts remain unchanged.

wire_types.integer_string: Canonical signed base-10 integer JSON string, no exponent, leading plus, leading zeros or negative zero. Current producer values are integral, including raw fee factors and Q64.96. Legacy fractional/non-finite numeric values fail migration validation; never round them.
wire_types.ton_address: Canonical signed-workchain:64 uppercase hex digits; null remains null. No conversion through int8 workchain.
wire_types.hash_base64: RFC4648 standard padded base64 of exactly32 bytes.
wire_types.bytes_base64: RFC4648 standard padded base64 of original bytes. For BOCs preserve bytes; never reserialize during backfill.
wire_types.string: Preserve textual value exactly, including empty string. Field-specific representation follows the mapped legacy field.
wire_types.boolean: JSON true or false, not numeric or string.
